# 1. Problem 5.8

## data import
```{r}
students <- read_table("Students.dat.txt")
head(students)
```

## (a)
```{r}
# Extract political ideology data
x <- na.omit(students$ideol)

# Sample statistics
n <- length(x)
x_bar <- mean(x)
s <- sd(x)

# Standard error
SE <- s / sqrt(n)

# Hypotheses
# H0: mu = 4
# Ha: mu != 4
mu_0 <- 4
alpha <- 0.05

# Calculate t-statistic
df <- n - 1
t_stat <- (x_bar - mu_0) / SE

# Calculate two-sided P-value
p_value <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df)

# Hypothesis test conclusion
cat("Sample size:", n, "\n")
cat("Sample mean:", x_bar, "\n")
cat("Sample SD:", s, "\n")
cat("Standard error:", SE, "\n")
cat("t-statistic:", t_stat, "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", df, "\n")
cat("P-value:", p_value, "\n")

if (p_value < alpha) {
  cat("Reject H0 at alpha = 0.05.\n")
  cat("The population mean differs significantly from 4.\n")
} else {
  cat("Fail to reject H0 at alpha = 0.05.\n")
  cat("Insufficient evidence that the mean differs from 4.\n")
}

```

## (b) 
```{r}
# Calculate critical value
t_critical <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = df)

# Calculate confidence interval
lower <- x_bar - t_critical * SE
upper <- x_bar + t_critical * SE

# Display confidence interval
cat("Critical t-value:", t_critical, "\n")
cat("95% CI: (", lower, ",", upper, ")\n")

# Compare with hypothesis test
if (mu_0 < lower || mu_0 > upper) {
  cat("4 is outside the 95% CI.\n")
  cat("This agrees with rejecting H0 in part (a).\n")
} else {
  cat("4 is inside the 95% CI.\n")
  cat("This agrees with failing to reject H0 in part (a).\n")
}
```
